title: link_schc.h lichen_link_compress contract doc omits newly-visible SCHC_ERR_NO_MATCHING_RULE
description: P3 doc fix, found by worker5 subagent robustness pass of project-LICHEN-worker6-hahk. lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/link_schc.h:59-61 documents lichen_link_compress returning only SCHC_ERR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL. With the hahk gate, the wrapped lichen_schc_compress now also returns SCHC_ERR_NO_MATCHING_RULE for malformed packets - and that is now the most likely TX-side failure for callers of this wrapper. The wrapper currently has no callers (verified by grep), so doc-only. Fix: add SCHC_ERR_NO_MATCHING_RULE (malformed packet rejected by the compress gate) to the contract comment. Also noted in the same robustness pass (opinion, no bead): lichen_link_strerror (lichen_util.h:90-155) has no SCHC cases so -1 logs as unknown error, and lichen_l2_to_zephyr_errno passes -1 through so Zephyr callers see -EPERM; pre-existing mapping gap worth folding into any error-mapping bead.
close_reason: Re-close: store merge resurrected pre-close state. The close stands: link_schc.h compress/decompress error contracts completed (-1 gate-malformed, -2 out-too-small OR oversized-input, -6 NULL/short/non-IPv6 plus rule-7 policy; decompress -6 malformed residue), commit b1beac4250, 3x reviewer passes PASS (2+1 findings fixed), pgsl filed for the rule-7 policy question. See prior close reason.
